questions.q_en:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if '+' and ' - ' are interchanged and ' X ' and '÷' are Interchanged?

2736 X 8 - 55 + 105 ÷ 2 = ?
questions.solution_en:
Apply the swaps:

• " X " becomes "÷" and "÷" becomes " X "

• "+" and " - " interchange

Thus, the new expression is:

 2736 ÷ 8 + 55 − 105 X 2

Calculate step by step:

• 2736 ÷ 8 = 342

• 105 X 2 = 210

Then, 342 + 55 = 397 and finally 397 − 210 = 187.

Option (c) is the correct answer.

In a certain code language,

P δ Q means 'P is the husband of Q'

P Ω Q means 'P is the daughter's father-in-law of Q'

P θ Q means 'P is the wife of Q'

P < Q means 'Q is the only child of P'

questions.solution_en:
A Ω B δ C < D θ E

A Ω B means 'A is the daughter's father-in-law of B'

B δ C means 'B is the husband of C'

C < D means 'D is the only child of C'

D θ E means 'D is the wife of E'

C is E's wife's mother.

questions.q_en: A clock which moves continuously fast, it lags 10 minutes on Tuesday 10 AM, it is ahead 14 minutes on Friday 10 AM. Find when the clock showed the right time.

Time between Tuesday 10 AM to Friday 10 AM = 72 hour

Formula: X Total = X 72 = X 72 = 30 hour

Tuesday 10 AM + 30 hour = Wednesday 4 PM
